title: Rockwell Automation / Allen-Bradley
summary: Allen-Bradley Logix controllers (CompactLogix, ControlLogix) are programmed with Studio 5000 Logix Designer and use tag-based memory and EtherNet/IP.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body:
| Family | Role |
| --- | --- |
| CompactLogix | Mid-range controllers with local Compact I/O (1769) or 5069 I/O |
| ControlLogix | Chassis-based high-end controllers (1756) |
| POINT I/O / FLEX I/O | Distributed I/O on EtherNet/IP |

sections.heading: Conventions worth knowing
sections.body:
- Memory is **tag-based**; I/O appears as module-defined tags such as `Local:1:I.Data.0`.
- Ladder Diagram is dominant; Structured Text, FBD and SFC are available.
- Timers use a TIMER structure with PRE, ACC and DN bits.
- Analog modules can scale to engineering units in the module configuration.
